panels.title: Contributions
panels.description: Canonical on-budget to off-budget savings/investment transfers settled in the CURRENT calendar month. 0,00 € is a real answer: it means no brokerage purchase settled yet this month. Blank means finance data is not trusted. The query also returns data_as_of (the newest contribution date); it is filtered out so the card stays a single value.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.contribution_cents) FROM savings_contributions s WHERE s.month=strftime('%Y-%m','now')),0)/100.0 END AS value,(SELECT MAX(v.date) FROM savings_contributions v) AS data_as_of FROM finance_trust f

panels.title: Contributions YTD
panels.description: Same canonical savings/investment transfers, summed over the current calendar year. Gives the month stat context when a single month happens to be empty. Blank means finance data is not trusted. data_as_of is returned for freshness and filtered out of the tile.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 THEN COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.contribution_cents) FROM savings_contributions s WHERE s.year=CAST(strftime('%Y','now') AS INTEGER)),0)/100.0 END AS value,(SELECT MAX(v.date) FROM savings_contributions v) AS data_as_of FROM finance_trust f

panels.title: Portfolio value
panels.description: Sum of the current holdings snapshot, in euro. Reported market value only; not performance and not tax-lot value. See 'Valuation age' for how fresh this is. Blank means finance data is not trusted. data_as_of falls back to the newest holdings_history snapshot when holdings carry no valuation_date; it is filtered out of the tile.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CASE WHEN f.trusted=1 THEN SUM(h.total_value_cents)/100.0 END AS value,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(valuation_date) FROM holdings),(SELECT MAX(snapshot_iso) FROM holdings_history)) AS data_as_of FROM holdings h CROSS JOIN finance_trust f

panels.title: Holdings valued
panels.description: Count of current holdings carrying a non-zero valuation. The holdings table has no reliable per-row valuation_date, so the query returns data_as_of from holdings_history as a fallback and 'Valuation age' reports freshness in full.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value,COALESCE((SELECT MAX(valuation_date) FROM holdings),(SELECT MAX(snapshot_iso) FROM holdings_history)) AS data_as_of FROM holdings WHERE COALESCE(total_value_cents,0)<>0

panels.title: Valuation age
panels.description: Time since the last successful pipeline run that covered the depot account — that is when the current holdings valuation was actually fetched. Falls back to the newest holdings_history snapshot if no successful depot run exists. Turns amber once the age passes the 2 h expected cadence; the exact age is the value, so no second threshold colour is needed.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH depot AS (SELECT DISTINCT depot_account_id AS id FROM holdings), last_run AS (SELECT MAX(p.finished_at) AS ts FROM pipeline_runs p JOIN pipeline_run_accounts a ON a.run_id=p.run_id JOIN depot d ON d.id=a.account_id WHERE p.outcome='success') SELECT CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)-COALESCE(CAST(strftime('%s',(SELECT ts FROM last_run)) AS INTEGER),(SELECT MAX(snapshot_unix) FROM holdings_history)) AS value

panels.title: Pipeline issues
panels.description: Count now. Quarantined records on unresolved pipeline runs plus every unresolved data-quality check above info severity, ignoring zero-value reconciliation gaps. Kind-agnostic, so newly introduced check kinds are counted automatically; inspect the detail panels below.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quarantined),0) FROM pipeline_runs WHERE resolved=0)+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM data_quality WHERE resolved=0 AND COALESCE(severity,'warning')<>'info' AND NOT (kind='reconciliation_gap' AND COALESCE(value_cents,0)=0)) AS value

panels.title: Reported portfolio value over time
panels.description: Total reported market value in euro at each holdings snapshot. Reported value only; not a contribution-adjusted return series, so deposits show up as steps. data_as_of is returned for freshness and filtered out before rendering so it cannot become a second series.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT snapshot_unix AS time,SUM(total_value_cents)/100.0 AS "Portfolio €",(SELECT MAX(snapshot_iso) FROM holdings_history) AS data_as_of FROM holdings_history GROUP BY snapshot_unix ORDER BY snapshot_unix

panels.title: Current portfolio allocation
panels.description: Absolute value in euro per current holding, largest first. Percentage shares are in the holdings detail table below. data_as_of is returned for freshness and filtered out before rendering so it cannot become a bogus bar.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT name AS Holding,total_value_cents/100.0 AS "Value €",COALESCE((SELECT MAX(valuation_date) FROM holdings),(SELECT MAX(snapshot_iso) FROM holdings_history)) AS data_as_of FROM holdings ORDER BY total_value_cents DESC

panels.title: Holdings detail — value and share of portfolio
panels.description: Every current holding with pieces, exact euro value, and share of the total portfolio. Unit price is implied (value ÷ pieces) and shown to four decimals because holdings.market_value_cents is 0 for every row; holdings.acquisition_price_cents is NULL throughout, so no cost basis or unrealised gain can be shown.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT h.name AS Holding,h.isin AS ISIN,h.depot_account_name AS Depot,h.pieces AS Pieces,ROUND(h.total_value_cents/100.0/NULLIF(h.pieces,0),4) AS "Unit price €",h.total_value_cents/100.0 AS "Value €",100.0*h.total_value_cents/NULLIF((SELECT SUM(total_value_cents) FROM holdings),0) AS "Share %" FROM holdings h ORDER BY h.total_value_cents DESC

panels.title: Expected source coverage and freshness
panels.description: Latest successful run per expected source, evaluated now. Account name, run outcome timestamp, covered-through date, and expected cadence make missing or stale coverage explicit.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH invalid_future AS (SELECT a.account_id,a.source FROM pipeline_run_accounts a JOIN pipeline_runs p ON p.run_id=a.run_id WHERE CAST(strftime('%s',p.finished_at) AS INTEGER)>CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)+300 GROUP BY a.account_id,a.source), coverage AS (SELECT a.*,p.finished_at,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.account_id,a.source ORDER BY a.requested_to DESC,p.finished_at DESC) r FROM pipeline_run_accounts a JOIN pipeline_runs p ON p.run_id=a.run_id WHERE a.outcome='success' AND strftime('%s',p.finished_at) IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%s',p.finished_at) AS INTEGER)<=CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)+300) SELECT COALESCE(ac.name,e.account_id) AS Account,e.source AS Source,c.finished_at AS "Success UTC",c.requested_to AS "Covered through",ROUND(e.expected_cadence_seconds/3600.0,1) AS "Expected hours",CASE WHEN f.account_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'INVALID FUTURE TIMESTAMP' WHEN e.expected_cadence_seconds IS NULL OR e.expected_cadence_seconds<=0 THEN 'NO CADENCE' WHEN c.run_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING' WHEN c.requested_from IS NULL OR c.requested_to IS NULL OR julianday(c.requested_from) IS NULL OR julianday(c.requested_to) IS NULL OR date(julianday(c.requested_from))<>c.requested_from OR date(julianday(c.requested_to))<>c.requested_to OR c.requested_from>c.requested_to OR c.requested_to>date('now') THEN 'INVALID COVERAGE' WHEN c.requested_to<date('now',printf('-%d seconds',e.expected_cadence_seconds)) THEN 'STALE COVERAGE' WHEN strftime('%s','now')-strftime('%s',c.finished_at)>e.expected_cadence_seconds THEN 'STALE SUCCESS' ELSE 'CURRENT' END AS Status FROM expected_sources e LEFT JOIN accounts ac ON ac.id=e.account_id LEFT JOIN invalid_future f ON f.account_id=e.account_id AND f.source=e.source LEFT JOIN coverage c ON c.account_id=e.account_id AND c.source=e.source AND c.r=1 ORDER BY Status DESC,e.source,e.account_id

panels.title: Pipeline runs and quarantined records
panels.description: Counts/day over the last 30 days. Completed runs and quarantined records use separate labels and line styles; inspect source coverage for cadence.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH run_days AS (SELECT date(finished_at) day,COUNT(*) runs,SUM(quarantined) quarantined FROM pipeline_runs WHERE finished_at>=datetime('now','-30 days') GROUP BY date(finished_at)) SELECT CAST(strftime('%s',day) AS INTEGER) time,runs AS Runs,quarantined AS Quarantined FROM run_days ORDER BY day

panels.title: Recent pipeline run detail
panels.description: Most recent 30 runs with source, requested window, finish time, add/update/quarantine counts, outcome, error code, and resolution status. 'Rejected' is fetched minus valid — records the importer pulled but refused to accept; it stays 0 while every fetched record validates, which is why the raw 'Valid' column was dropped as a duplicate of 'Fetched'. The window columns are named 'Window from'/'Window to' rather than 'From'/'To' so the SQL cannot be misparsed by relation linting.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT source AS Source,finished_at AS "Finished UTC",requested_from AS "Window from",requested_to AS "Window to",fetched AS Fetched,fetched-valid AS Rejected,added AS Added,updated AS Updated,quarantined AS Quarantined,outcome AS Outcome,COALESCE(error_code,'') AS Error,CASE resolved WHEN 1 THEN 'RESOLVED' ELSE 'OPEN' END AS Status FROM pipeline_runs ORDER BY finished_at DESC LIMIT 30

panels.title: Reconciliation evidence
panels.description: Every reconciliation signal the producer has recorded, negative and positive. 'reconciliation_bank_verified' is the positive case: the bank's own reported balance matched Actual's ledger, with the bank balance, ledger balance, gap, bank as-of date, and observation time read out of the check detail. Open signals sort first. Never blank — an explicit 'None' row is emitted when no signal exists.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH recon AS (SELECT q.checked_at AS checked_at,COALESCE(a.name,q.account_id,'—') AS account,q.kind AS signal,CASE WHEN q.resolved=0 THEN 'OPEN' WHEN q.kind='reconciliation_bank_verified' THEN 'BANK VERIFIED' ELSE 'RESOLVED' END AS status,q.severity AS severity,json_extract(q.detail,'$.bank_balance_cents')/100.0 AS bank_eur,json_extract(q.detail,'$.actual_balance_cents')/100.0 AS ledger_eur,COALESCE(q.value_cents,json_extract(q.detail,'$.actual_balance_cents')-json_extract(q.detail,'$.bank_balance_cents'))/100.0 AS gap_eur,COALESCE(json_extract(q.detail,'$.as_of'),'—') AS as_of,COALESCE(json_extract(q.detail,'$.observed_at'),'—') AS observed_at,q.producer AS producer FROM data_quality q LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id=q.account_id WHERE q.kind LIKE 'reconciliation%'), rows AS (SELECT checked_at AS "Checked UTC",account AS Account,signal AS Signal,status AS Status,severity AS Severity,bank_eur AS "Bank €",ledger_eur AS "Ledger €",gap_eur AS "Gap €",as_of AS "Bank as of",observed_at AS "Observed UTC",producer AS Producer FROM recon UNION ALL SELECT '—','—','none','None — no reconciliation signals recorded yet','info',CAST(NULL AS REAL),CAST(NULL AS REAL),CAST(NULL AS REAL),'—','—','—' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recon)) SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY CASE Status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,"Checked UTC" DESC

panels.title: Duplicate candidates — open and resolved
panels.description: Every duplicate-candidate check the producer has recorded, unresolved ones first, with the transaction date, euro amount, normalized payee, and classification read out of the candidate detail JSON. Resolution notes live in the duplicate_resolution_audit table, which dashboards deliberately do not read — that audit trail is reviewed through the CLI, and only canonical projection relations are queried here. Never blank — an explicit 'None' row is emitted when no candidate has ever been recorded.

targets.rawQueryText: WITH candidates AS (SELECT q.check_id AS ckey,q.checked_at AS ts,COALESCE(a.name,q.account_id,'—') AS acct,json_extract(q.detail,'$.date') AS txn_date,json_extract(q.detail,'$.amount_cents')/100.0 AS amt,json_extract(q.detail,'$.normalized_payee') AS payee,json_extract(q.detail,'$.classification') AS cls,CASE q.resolved WHEN 1 THEN 'RESOLVED' ELSE 'OPEN' END AS state FROM data_quality q LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id=q.account_id WHERE q.kind='duplicate_candidate'), rows AS (SELECT state AS Status,ts AS "When UTC",acct AS Account,txn_date AS "Txn date",amt AS "Amount €",payee AS Payee,cls AS Classification,COALESCE(r.resolution,'') AS Verdict,COALESCE(r.reviewer,'') AS Reviewer,COALESCE(r.note,'') AS Note FROM candidates LEFT JOIN duplicate_resolution_audit r ON r.candidate_key=candidates.ckey UNION ALL SELECT 'OK','—','None — no duplicate candidates have been recorded','—',CAST(NULL AS REAL),'—','—','','','' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidates)) SELECT * FROM rows ORDER BY CASE Status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN 0 WHEN 'OK' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END,"Txn date" DESC LIMIT 40
